notes.c01: Old c01 is Layla's own introduction (secret base, family, hidden training), which the new book tells in c02. Mapped to c01 because it opens the book and shows her as the always first student on the rank board.
notes.i-far-above-1: Obsidia watching the Academy with a pawn on a board. The nearest opening moment is the Prologue.
notes.c05: Vexana's childhood and her father's death are not shown as scenes. Her first sight of Guinevere is in c22. Her father is only recalled in c40.
notes.c11: The festival and the family before 978 are not shown. Lesley's family appears only as a memory in c17.
notes.c12: The cellar night of 978 is not shown as a scene. Her family's death is a short memory in c17.
notes.c13: The naming of the Enders and the founding of the Shield are only summarized in the opening paragraphs of c01. The base and the scientists who take in Chang'e are set up in c17.
notes.c14: Lesley's recovery, the Cadet Corps and her posting to the base are compressed into one paragraph of c17.
notes.c15: Chang'e's childhood with her parents appears only in c19, on the day they die. Mapped to c17 for her first meeting with Lesley and Mr. Bunny.
notes.c18: Lesley leaving on a secret mission is only mentioned in c17. The line 'I hate scary Big Sis' moved to c28.
notes.c22: The founding of the Academy is a single line in c28.
notes.c23: Selena building Silverbolt and spying for the Enders are not shown. The nearest scene is Selena with Chang'e in c07. Her inner story is in c42.
notes.c24: The origin of the Will, the Mother Matrix and the cycle of purges is not told as a scene. Obsidia's view of that history is in c31.
notes.c25: The first awakening of Obsidia is compressed into a few lines of the Prologue.
notes.c26: Obsidia making the child and hiding the recall in her blood is compressed into the Prologue and into c42.
notes.c28: The Oro scout craft and the Control Core crystal are not in the new book. The Core is explained in Chang'e's lesson in c24.
notes.c29: Lesley's mission to Oro is not in the new book. The nearest moment is the Control Core lesson in c24.
notes.c36: The Enders' attack on Oro does not happen in the new book. The nearest moment is the Council's decision in c12.
notes.c37: The Council's use of the Core is not in the new book. The nearest moment is the Council's plan in c12.
notes.c41: Guinevere and Vexana in the great battle. The closest scene is the swarm fight in c23. Their other fights are in c09 and c26.
notes.i-far-above-2: Obsidia's reaction after the landing. The nearest is her scene with the recall and the pawn in c21.
notes.c52: Selena refusing the recall and Karina's lamp are in c42. The graduation ceremony and the Appreciation Society are not in the new book.
notes.c54: The Chairman, Harlan and the Aspirant Field are not in the new book. The rally and the rescue party are in c34.
notes.c60: The new book stops before the aftermath. Mapped to the last chapter.
